scope.primary_question: Quantify within- and among-taxon spatial associations between auditable image-defined capitulum phenotype modules and a phenotype-blind, pre-frozen abiotic exposure representation in the native range.
scope.biotic_scope: Pollinator filtering and other biotic mechanisms are outside the current estimand because no directly comparable global exposure layer is available. They may be discussed only as untested alternative mechanisms and are not a completion gate for Chapter 1 v3.
scope.causal_ceiling: Spatial association does not establish plasticity, selection, adaptation, mechanism, independent origin or convergence.

design_hold.reason: Environment and measurement qualification are frozen without inspecting v3 trait-environment coefficients. A phenotype-blind ecological source cohort was built in run 34174862892, but source-link reconciliation, timing/imaging nuisance terms, covariance-aware hierarchical inference and persistent numerical products require validation before original-image trait execution is joined to environmental exposures.
next_required_artifacts: phenotype-blind full native-range species-level source cohort receipt and digest
pre-outcome taxon-support rules for hierarchical slope interpretation
validated reconciled photo links, calendar/imaging covariates, hierarchical covariance and private numerical retention
